policy_metadata.policy_title: Laboratory – Diagnosis of Idiopathic Environmental Intolerance

sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. • At a general wellness exam, testing for chlorinated pesticides (CPT code 82441), including dichlorodiphenyldichloroethylene (DDE) and dichlorodiphenyltrichloroethane (DDT), using a blood, serum, plasma, saliva, urine or stool sample IS NOT REIMBURSABLE . • At a general wellness exam for individuals over the age of four, testing blood, serum, plasma, saliva, urine or stool sample IS NOT REIMBURSABLE for any of the following: – 5-Hydroxyindolacetic acid (5-HIAA) (CPT code 83497) – Amino acids (CPT code 82127, CPT code 82136, CPT code 82139) – Allergen-specific immunoglobulin G (IgG) (CPT code 86001*) – Behenic acid (CPT code 82542) – Carotene or beta-carotene (CPT code 82380) – Carnitine (CPT code 82379^^) – Citrate (CPT code 82507) – Elastase (CPT code 82653, CPT code 82656) – Fat differentiation, qualitative or quantitative (CPT code 82705, CPT code 82710, CPT code 82715) – Fat stain (CPT code 89125) – Gastrointestinal fat absorption study (CPT code S3708) – Glutathione (CPT code 82978) – Homovanillic acid (HVA) (CPT code 83150) – Lignoceric acid (CPT code 82542) – Lipid peroxides (CPT code 82542) – Prealbumin (CPT code 84134) – Vanillylmandelic acid (VMA) (CPT code 84585) • At a general wellness exam, testing blood, serum, urine, cerebrospinal fluid, fingernails, hair or stool sample IS NOT REIMBURSABLE for any of the following: – Cadmium (CPT code 82300***) – Chromium (CPT code 82495***) – Copper (CPT code 82525***) – Heavy metal, qualitative or quantitative (CPT code 83015***, CPT code 83018***) – Magnesium (CPT code 83735*^) – Manganese (CPT code 83785***) – Nickel (CPT code 83885***) – Organic acids, qualitative or quantitative (CPT code 83918, CPT code 83919, CPT code 83921) – Selenium (CPT code 84255***) – Tocopherol alpha, also known as vitamin E (CPT code 84446^^) – Vitamin A (CPT code 84590^^) – Volatiles (CPT code 84600) – Zinc (CPT code 84630***)

subsections.heading: Applicable procedures for Medicare Advantage plans
content: Insurance Corporation, CGS Administrators, LLC, National Government Services, and Novitas Solutions, Inc. *^ The payment criterion for 83735 applies to all Medicare jurisdictions, except those states awarded to Noridian Healthcare Solutions, and Palmetto GBA. ^^ The payment criterion for 82379, 84446, 84590 applies to all Medicare jurisdictions, except those states awarded to Novitas Solutions. *** The payment criteria for 83785, 82300, 83015, 83885, 82495, 84255, 84630, 82525, and 83018 apply to all Medicare jurisdictions, except those states awarded to National Government Services, Inc.
